name: feedback-routing
body: The behaviour that mediates the closed feedback cycle across the coordinator, the writers, and the reviewers: the coordinator dispatches one feedback item to the one writer that owns its target (the spec-writer for a spec-tier target, the plan-writer for a plan/phase/task target, the implementer for a code target); the writer returns an ACTIONED/WONT-FIX claim; the coordinator performs a shallow consistency check of the claim, actions the item (`--fix`/`--wont-fix`), or re-dispatches it to the owning writer; the reviewer retains the terminal resolve/reject. It never batches items and never lets the writer move feedback state. Realised by the coordinator-mediated feedback routing in the distributed agent prompts and the `apg_review_action` tool text.
